none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Ahmed Khaled, Othmane Sebbouh, Nicolas Loizou, Robert M. Gower, Peter Richtárik. [Unified Analysis of Stochastic Gradient Methods for Composite Convex and Smooth Optimization](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2006.11573v1). 2023 publication; 2020 preprint v1. Complexity: $O(1+(LR^2+\Delta)/\varepsilon+\sigma^2R^2/\varepsilon^2)$ total stochastic-gradient and exact proximal oracle calls, with a fixed budget, for averaged proximal SGD achieving expected composite objective gap at most $\varepsilon$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F(x)=Eξ[loss(ξ,x)]+ψ(x) over a nonempty closed convex set Q. Every sampled loss is convex, and ψ is convex on Q and lower semicontinuous. A minimizer x⋆ exists.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The expected smooth loss is combined with a potentially nonsmooth convex regularizer and a constraint set; exact proximal minimization includes both ψ and Q.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query at x returns grad(ξ,x), the exact gradient of a fresh IID sampled loss. The law and sampled functions are hidden instance data. No function values or reusable sample identifiers are returned.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, a query (a,z,g) returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨g,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries each consume one call from the same oracle budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only solution variance is bounded: Eξ‖grad(ξ,x⋆)−Eζ grad(ζ,x⋆)‖²≤σ² at a minimizer satisfying the initialization bounds. There is no uniform variance bound over x, bounded-gradient assumption, or exponential-tail assumption.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a second-countable real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure, possibly infinite-dimensional. Every sampled gradient is globally L-Lipschitz. Public parameters include x0,L,R,Δ,σ,ε, with L,R,ε>0 and Δ,σ≥0; x0∈Q, ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, and F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ. Q need not be bounded.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned E-valued point must be measurable, its objective gap integrable, and E[F(output)−F(x⋆)]≤ε for a minimizer over Q. The successful predicate does not separately require output∈Q or specify averaging; allowedAlgorithm restricts the permitted algorithm family.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, under a fixed total oracle budget; it is not a high-probability guarantee.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: An established stochastic composite convex optimization formulation with IID sample gradients, samplewise smoothness, solution-only variance control, exact proximal access, and expected objective error. The Hilbert-space scope and restricted algorithm family require separate applicability checks.
